bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; appropriating money to Independent School District No. 318, Grand Rapids, for American Indian mascot removal and replacement costs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; INDEPENDENT SCHOOL DISTRICT NO. 318, GRAND RAPIDS; AMERICAN INDIAN MASCOT REMOVAL AND REPLACEMENT COSTS.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

Independent School District No. 318, Grand Rapids; American Indian mascot removal and replacement costs.

(a) To Independent School District No. 318, Grand Rapids, for American Indian mascot removal and replacement costs to comply with Minnesota Statutes, section 121A.041:

$

1,000,000

.....

2026

(b) The commissioner must reimburse the school district for the costs of removing and replacing an American Indian mascot on school facilities and equipment, including athletic uniforms, clocks, school signage, tribute markers, chairs, tables, entryway flooring, gymnasium flooring, athletic field artificial turf, and gymnasium wall mats. To be eligible for reimbursement, an expense must have been incurred by the school district on or after June 1, 2023.

(c) This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: APPROPRIATION; INDEPENDENT SCHOOL DISTRICT NO. 318, GRAND RAPIDS; AMERICAN INDIAN MASCOT REMOVAL AND REPLACEMENT COSTS.
The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal year designated.
Independent School District No. 318, Grand Rapids; American Indian mascot removal and replacement costs.
(a) To Independent School District No. 318, Grand Rapids, for American Indian mascot removal and replacement costs to comply with Minnesota Statutes, section 121A.041:

(b) The commissioner must reimburse the school district for the costs of removing and replacing an American Indian mascot on school facilities and equipment, including athletic uniforms, clocks, school signage, tribute markers, chairs, tables, entryway flooring, gymnasium flooring, athletic field artificial turf, and gymnasium wall mats. To be eligible for reimbursement, an expense must have been incurred by the school district on or after June 1, 2023.
(c) This appropriation is available until June 30, 2027. This is a onetime appropriation.
